lines.text: Many learners say: The bottle is 1,5 liters.
Write it with a point, like in 1.5.
The second! The bottle is 2.5 liters.

data.why: Write it with a point, like in 1.5.

native.tip: Türkçede “1,5” yazarız; İngilizcede ondalık sayıda virgül değil nokta kullanılır: “1.5”.
native.caption: “The bottle is 1,5 liters” mi yazıyorsun? 😅 İngilizcede ondalık sayıda virgül yerine nokta yazılır. Doğrusu “The bottle is 1.5 liters.” Carlos’u dinle ve tekrar et! Lexkite uygulamasını aç, daha çok pratik yap.
native.comment: Cevap: “The bottle is 2.5 liters”. Ondalıkta nokta kullan. Şimdi kendi cümleni yaz ve sesli söyle: {link}

en.hook: There is a period in the decimal,
en.tip: In English a number like one and a half is written “1.5”.
en.caption: Do you write “The bottle is 1,5 liters”? 😅 In English we write 1.5 with a point, not with a comma like 1,5. The right sentence is “The bottle is 1.5 liters.” Listen to Carlos and repeat! Open the Lexkite app and practice more.
